title: Management Intern
description:
**Company Description** 
 HIPCASTLE is a clothing brand built around the values of resilience, growth, and quiet strength. The brand creates “growthwear” for individuals who are focused on building themselves, pushing through challenges, and choosing long\-term progress over short\-term comfort. Each piece is designed to reflect effort, patience, and the courage to start over. HIPCASTLE aims to be a calm, motivating presence in people’s lives, supporting those who are becoming something greater, one day at a time.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Management Intern role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Goregaon. The intern will support day\-to\-day operations, including coordinating with cross\-functional teams, assisting with inventory and vendor management, and helping ensure smooth store and back\-office workflows. Responsibilities may include preparing reports, tracking performance metrics, supporting marketing and brand initiatives, and contributing to process improvements. The intern will also assist in planning and execution of events or campaigns, participate in meetings, and provide administrative support where needed. This role offers exposure to end\-to\-end brand management and operations within a growing apparel company.
   

**Qualifications**
* Ability to assist with operational tasks such as coordination, scheduling, basic data entry, and report preparation.
* Comfort with using office productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, word processing, presentation software) and learning new systems.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Demonstrated organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment.
* Interest in fashion, apparel, or lifestyle brands, and willingness to understand HIPCASTLE’s values and target audience.
* Proactive mindset, willingness to take initiative, and openness to feedback and learning.
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Management, Business, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Ability to work on\-site in Goregaon for full\-time hours and maintain a professional, inclusive work ethic.

title: Digital Media Leader
description:
📌 Job Description – Digital Media Leader
 



 Position: Digital Media Leader
 



 Location: Mumbai (or as per company HQ)
 



 Industry: Media Monitoring / Digital Analytics
 



 Experience: 10\+ years in digital media, analytics, or communications leadership
 



  





 🎯
 **Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a Digital Media Leader to drive strategy, execution, and innovation in our media monitoring and digital engagement operations. The role requires expertise in media analytics, digital campaigns, and team leadership to strengthen brand visibility and client impact.
 



  





 🛠
 **Key Responsibilities** 



* Digital Strategy Development: Build and execute digital media strategies aligned with business goals.
* Media Monitoring \& Insights: Track brand mentions, sentiment, and competitor activity using advanced tools (Meltwater, Brandwatch, Talkwalker).
* Social Media Leadership: Manage presence across LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook, driving measurable ROI.
* Content \& Campaign Management: Oversee creation of impactful content and digital campaigns.
* Client \& Stakeholder Engagement: Deliver reports, insights, and recommendations to clients and senior management.
* Team Leadership: Mentor analysts and digital executives, fostering a high‑performance culture.
* Crisis Communication: Manage digital narratives during sensitive events to protect brand reputation.



  





 📚
 **Qualifications** 



* Education: Bachelor’s in Mass Communication, Journalism, Marketing, or Business Administration.
* Preferred: Master’s in Digital Marketing / MBA in Marketing or Strategy.
* Certifications: Google Analytics, SEO/SEM, Meltwater, Brandwatch, HubSpot, or equivalent.



  





 ✅
 **Desired Skills** 



* Strong analytical mindset with ability to interpret large datasets.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Proven track record in digital campaign success and ROI improvement.
* Ability to lead cross‑functional teams and manage multiple projects.

 If interested, please apply using the Google Form link: https://forms.gle/gsTAypAiPiLfQo7UA
 



  





 Kindly please check the Careers page \- https://www.arpan.org.in/careers/
 



  





**About Arpan** 




 Arpan is a globally recognised, award\-winning non\-profit working towards the elimination of Child
 



 Sexual Abuse (CSA) in India.
 



 Based in Mumbai, with a team of over 150 dedicated professionals, Arpan is India’s largest non\-profit providing CSA Prevention and Intervention services for both children and adults. As a critical stakeholder for state and non\-state actors, Arpan is a leading voice in the space of CSA Prevention and Intervention in India and uses advocacy and research to push for policy and systemic change at the local, state and
 



 national levels.
 



 Arpan is a global thought leader in the CSA space, with innovative impact models that work with range of stakeholders, from children and parents to state bodies and teachers. Arpan’s key project focuses on Personal Safety Education in schools, teaching children and adolescents (ages 4 to 18\) about personal safety so they can identify and seek help in unsafe situations. Arpan also trains and empowers teachers and parents with the knowledge, attitude and skills needed to prevent and deal with CSA. Since 2007,
 



 Arpan has impacted over 19\.4 million children and adults and has received 8 National and 2
 



 International Awards for its exemplary work.
 



 For more details \- www.arpan.org.in
 



  





**About Child Protection Policy of ARPAN** 




 Arpan’s work is child\-centric where the key is to understand and value what the child wants and hence the child is an integral part of the decision\-making process. This philosophy extends to all the programmes at Arpan, where children are the primary stakeholders. Arpan expects that all board members, advisors, donors, partners, employees, volunteers, interns, consultants, partner counsellors and contractors agree to fully comply with Arpan’s Child Protection Policy. For more details, read on the
 



 below link \- https://www.arpan.org.in/child\-protection\-policy/
